title: Disclosed Intelligence: reproducibility artifact for a large-sample measurement of AI disclosure in U.S. investment adviser fiduciary filings
description: Frozen, pseudonymized dataset and a deterministic, network-free analysis pipeline that reproduces every table, figure, confidence interval, survey-weighted estimate, and the design-weighted independent cross-family validation reported in the article AI Use and Risk Disclosure by Investment Advisers. Includes the frozen stratified sample, primary and validation label sets, population stratum counts, venue/exposure tables, the classification rubric and exposure fingerprint, and the analysis code. Reproduction requires no API keys and no network access.
